Guidelines.Title: Tag in Good Faith
Guidelines.Text: Only add or remove tags when you genuinely believe the change is accurate.

Guidelines.Title: Follow the Official Tag Definitions
Guidelines.Text: Please follow our official tag definitions and do not reinterpret tags based on personal opinions or alternate meanings.

Guidelines.Title: No Vandalism or Malicious Editing
Guidelines.Text: Knowingly removing correct tags or adding incorrect ones is considered vandalism and is not allowed.

Guidelines.Title: Consequences for Violations
Guidelines.Text: Serious or repeated violations of those guidelines may result in your contribution rights being revoked.
